story.headline: Our Story
story.subtitle: Select a postcard from our journey in Montana

chapters.title: Bridger Canyon Hike
chapters.description: Wade and Autumn first met on a crisp October trail in the Bridger Mountains, talking for hours around a campfire under the stars.

chapters.title: Building Our Cabin
chapters.description: Together, they restored a rustic timber cabin surrounded by aspen trees and adopted their spirited blue heeler, Copper.

chapters.title: Lone Mountain Summit
chapters.description: Surrounded by golden larches at 11,000 feet, Wade asked Autumn to spend forever together on a clear autumn morning.

chapters.title: Willow Creek Wedding
chapters.description: Under the vast Montana sky, Wade and Autumn exchange vows surrounded by the people they cherish most.

story.footerNote: We can’t wait to celebrate the next chapter with you.

footer.title: Thank You for Celebrating With Us
footer.description: Your presence makes this celebration even more meaningful. We are grateful for every smile, story, and memory shared as we begin our life together.

schedule.headline: Schedule of Celebrations

items.title: Guest Arrival & Prelude
items.description: Welcome iced teas, artisanal lemonade, and acoustic prelude music under the shade of mature cottonwoods.

items.title: The Wedding Ceremony
items.description: Autumn & Wade exchange lifelong vows with sweeping 360-degree views of the Bridger Mountain Range.

items.title: Cocktail Hour & Lawn Games
items.description: Artisanal Montana craft spirits, local hors d'oeuvres, cornhole, and live acoustic music as dusk begins.

items.title: Dinner & Toasts
items.description: Farm-to-table western feast, heart-warming family toasts, and cake cutting under vintage timber chandeliers.

items.title: Dancing & Campfire Party
items.description: Live country band, dancing on the open cedar deck, s'mores around the campfire, and sparkler sendoff.
